_credit: Pattern content extracted (not copied wholesale) from two MIT-licensed rulesets: stop-slop by Hardik Pandya (https://github.com/hardikpandya/stop-slop) and no-ai-slop by Peter Yang (https://github.com/petergyang/no-ai-slop). Both MIT. Vendored locally per Creative Director directive 2026-08-16 — never fetched at runtime. The governing test: if a line could appear in any AI-generated game ever made, it is slop.
canon_exemption: Lines fixed verbatim as CANON in docs/NARRATIVE_BIBLE.md are exempt from every check (the reveal 'The door you opened wasn't the exit. It was the lock.' is canon, not a binary-contrast crutch). tools/slop.py loads the exemption list from the bible, not from memory.
banned_phrases: at the end of the day
x is a feature, not a bug

structural_patterns.name: binary-contrast
structural_patterns.fix: State Y directly. Drop the negation.

structural_patterns.name: negative-listing
structural_patterns.fix: Just say Z. The reader doesn't need the runway.

structural_patterns.name: colon-reveal
structural_patterns.fix: Colons are for lists, labels, quotes — not fake drama.

structural_patterns.name: dramatic-fragment
structural_patterns.fix: Complete sentences. Trust content over presentation.

structural_patterns.name: staccato-drama
structural_patterns.fix: X. And Y. And Z. is manufactured profundity.

structural_patterns.name: rhetorical-setup
structural_patterns.fix: Drop the setup and make the point.

structural_patterns.name: em-dash-crutch
structural_patterns.fix: Use commas or periods. No em dashes in game copy.

structural_patterns.name: false-agency
structural_patterns.fix: Name the actor. Inanimate things don't do human verbs.

structural_patterns.name: narrator-from-a-distance
structural_patterns.regex: \b(?:nobody designed this|this is why|people tend to)\b
structural_patterns.fix: Put the reader in the room, not above the scene.

structural_patterns.name: wh-opener
structural_patterns.fix: Lead with the subject or the verb.

scoring_rubric.note: LLM judgment pass scores this rubric; the mechanical regex pass runs first at zero API cost.
